There have been recent (2026) additions to the Kew tree of Life with more Rubiaceae species! In the following script I have manually created a file with ENA run accession numbers to download (raw sequences) (`OriginalData/PAFTOL_accessions.txt`). In the following script I download these using `wget` and save them in `OriginalData/PAFTOL_raw`. I am using the raw sequences rather than the prepared Angiosperm353 files to be able to do QC myself and to compare it to my own sequences.

The list of URLs contains 61 URLs (60 paired-end reads: R1, R2 for 30 species total) and one Angiosperm353-fasta file for *Dibridsonia conferta* for which I could not find the raw sequence data online. In total there are 31 species.

```{bash}
#| eval: false

accessions="$PROJ/OriginalData/PAFTOL_accessions.txt"
dst="$PROJ/OriginalData/PAFTOL_raw"

```

```{bash}
#| eval: false

downloads=0
while IFS= read -r url; do
    case "$url" in
        ftp://*|http://*|https://*) ;;
        *)
            printf 'Unsupported download URL: %s\n' "$url" >&2
            exit 1
            ;;
    esac

    printf 'Downloading %s\n' "$url"
    wget --continue --directory-prefix "$dst" "$url"
    ((downloads += 1))
done < "$url_list"

printf 'Finished downloading %d files to %s\n' "$downloads" "$dst"
```

Next, I rename the PAFTOL files to have the species name and R1/R2 instead of 1 and 2 for read-indication.

```{bash}
#| eval: false

# Rename the files using the species_name from column 2 of PAFTOL_accessions.txt. The accession file is UTF-16, so decode it before reading the tab-separated accession and species-name columns.
accession_map="$(mktemp)"
if ! iconv -f UTF-16 -t UTF-8 "$accessions" |
    awk -F '\t' 'NR > 1 && $1 ~ /^[[:alpha:]]+[[:digit:]]+$/ && $2 != "" { print $1 "\t" $2 }' > "$accession_map"; then
    printf 'Could not extract accession names from %s\n' "$accessions" >&2
    exit 1
fi

declare -A species_by_accession
while IFS=$'\t' read -r accession species_name; do
    species_by_accession["$accession"]="$species_name"
done < "$accession_map"

while IFS= read -r url; do
    filename=$(basename "$url")
    accession=""
    for candidate in "${!species_by_accession[@]}"; do
        if [[ "$url" =~ (^|[^[:alnum:]])${candidate}([^[:alnum:]]|$) ]]; then
            accession="$candidate"
            break
        fi
    done
    if [[ -z "$accession" ]]; then
        printf 'Accession not found for URL: %s\n' "$url" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
    species_name="${species_by_accession[$accession]// /_}"
    if [[ "$filename" == *_1.fastq.gz || "$filename" == *_R1.fastq.gz ]]; then
        new_filename="${species_name}_R1.fastq.gz"
    elif [[ "$filename" == *_2.fastq.gz || "$filename" == *_R2.fastq.gz ]]; then
        new_filename="${species_name}_R2.fastq.gz"
    elif [[ "$filename" == *.a353.fasta ]]; then
        new_filename="${species_name}.a353.fasta"
    else
        printf 'Unexpected filename format: %s\n' "$filename" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
    if [[ "$filename" != "$new_filename" ]]; then
        mv -- "$dst/$filename" "$dst/$new_filename"
    fi
    printf 'Renamed %s to %s\n' "$filename" "$new_filename"
done < "$url_list"
```
